think_procedure: Identify the knob’s data type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation/source defaults.
Check whether the knob defines any sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/unlimited).
If a sentinel exists and changes semantics beyond the normal ordered magnitude effect, classify it as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s).
Otherwise, if the knob’s effect varies monotonically/ordinally with the numeric value and no sentinel values exist, classify it as not special.
